notes.title: Patch 1.0.17a - 18th of September 2025
notes.content:
[h1]⚙️ Patch 1.0.17a – 18th of September 2025[/h1][p]
This update introduces important bug fixes, new systems, balance changes, and some much-needed polish across the game. Let’s get into it:

[/p][h2]🌍 World & Terrain[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed [b]Endale terrain[/b] to remove map holes where the river connects to new terrain.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added new [b]Points of Interest (POIs)[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] General [b]terrain design improvements[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] Implemented [b]custom shaders[/b] for better visuals.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]🖥️ UI & Menus[/h2][list][*][p] The [b]main menu[/b] now shows which account you’re logged in as when selecting a world.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a new [b]settings menu[/b], accessible in-game and with the ESC key.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a [b]temporary quality settings slider[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] Added [b]background FPS limit[/b] options for when the game window is unfocused.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Profile settings[/b] are now applied as the player spawns instead of only after opening the settings menu.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]💾 Stability & API[/h2][list][*][p] Added [b]safety checks[/b] to prevent corrupted save files (e.g. skills being set to invalid values).
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where players could theoretically gain levels above 100 due to excess experience handling.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an exploit where [b]empty item slots could be dropped[/b] server-side (clients can no longer attempt this).
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]🪓 Gathering[/h2][list][*][p] Fixed a bug where gathering would continue even if you had no tool.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where gathering without tools prevented re-gathering of the same resource.
[/p][/*][*][p] Gathering now chooses tools based on your [b]highest tier available[/b] and your skill level.
  [i](Known issue: it currently picks the first valid tool in your inventory — avoid carrying lower-level tools for now.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p] Added missing ground item for [b]Pine Logs[/b].
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]🎲 Loot & Drop Systems[/h2][list][*][p] Added a [b]server-side formula[/b] for a future “pity system”:
  - Extremely rare drops can instead provide [b]partial item parts[/b] at a higher rate.
  - Example: A 1/10,000 drop could instead provide 1% item parts at 1/400, with full drops shifted to 1/13,333.
  - Prevents endless dry streaks while still allowing lucky “spoon” moments.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a [b]drop table system[/b] for use in upcoming patches.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]⚔️ Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p] Strength scaling nerfed: [b]1 max hit per 3 Strength/Bonus[/b] (down from 6). [/p][/*][*][p] Boosted [b]gloves base Strength[/b]: 0.5 → 0.75.
[/p][/*][*][p] Boosted [b]boots base Strength[/b]: 0.25 → 0.5.
[/p][/*][*][p] Reduced [b]kite shield Strength[/b]: 1.5 → 1.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Halberds, Great Axes, Claymores[/b] are now 0.5s slower.
[/p][/*][*][p] All [b]1-handed weapons base Strength[/b] increased by +0.5.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]🛒 Shops[/h2][list][*][p] Selling items to shops is now supported.
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where “Sell All” would try to sell 0 items.
[/p][/*][*][p] Buying items beyond max stack size now clamps properly.
[/p][/*][*][p] Selling with a full coin stack no longer produces false “sold 0 for 0” messages.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added missing [b]ground item sprites[/b] for multi-sprite types (e.g. coins).
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]🧪 Testing & Debug Commands[/h2][list][*][p] Added [b]/test-tools-mining[/b] and [b]/test-tools-woodcutting[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p] Added [b]/armor-test[/b] for copper gear.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added [b]/armor-test-mid[/b] for crimsonite gear.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added [b]/armor-test-end[/b] for elderite gear.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added [b]/shop-test[/b] for testing shop exploits with max item and cash stacks.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]💬 Chat[/h2][list][*][p] Chat is now [b]rate-limited[/b] to 1 message per second (client-side).
[/p][/*][*][p] Failed messages due to rate limits will no longer wipe your text.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]🌐 Website[/h2][list][*][p] Hiscores and website now properly support [b]HTTPS[/b]: [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.16a - 13th of July 2025
notes.content:
[h1]🏝️ Patch Notes – Navigation Overhaul, Combat Fixes, UI Updates & Crusty Bill!?[/h1]

This update brings major improvements to pathfinding, gathering, tooltips, and NPC behaviors — plus some beachside surprises. Let’s dive in:

[h2]🗺️ Navigation & Minimap[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Player navigation is now entirely server-side[/b] for more accurate movement and future-proofing.
[*] [b]Click-to-move indicator[/b] is now a circle instead of a rectangle to reflect server-based nav.
[*] [b]Click-to-move target indicators[/b] now hide correctly when the target is reached.
[*] [b]Max movement distance[/b] increased from 175 → 200 meters and works server-side.
[*] [b]Minimap zoom[/b] has been added.
[*] [b]Click-to-move range indicator[/b] now displays on the minimap.
[*] Players now more accurately reach their clicked destination.
[*] Camera no longer zooms when scrolling over UI elements.
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ NPCs, Combat & Aggro[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with [b]NPC aggro and re-aggro[/b] logic.
[*] Players now properly [b]catch up to NPCs that slowly walk away[/b].
[*] NPC movement when idle is now significantly less erratic.
[*] NPCs now [b]stay within their defined roaming range[/b].
[*] NPCs now display a [b]roaming range indicator[/b] when hovered.
[*] Fixed combat-facing: [b]players now correctly face gathering and combat targets[/b].
[*] [b]Auto-retaliate[/b] can now be toggled on or off.
[*] Player ID/order is now [b]randomized every 1 minute[/b] (used by NPC targeting logic, may later apply to PvP).
[/list]

[h2]⛏️ Gathering Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Gathering animations now play correctly again[/b] across clients.
[*] Fixed an issue where animations played at incorrect intensity/scale.
[*] Re-gathering the same resource now works as intended.
[*] Gathering a [b]different resource mid-gathering[/b] now functions properly.
[*] Gathering now ends properly when your inventory is full and allows re-gathering after banking.
[*] Depleted resources now clear themselves as your "last gathering target" when they respawn.
[*] [b]Tree stump radius reduced[/b] from 0.5 → 0.25 to improve player positioning near felled trees.
[*] [b]Resource depletion updates[/b] now send correctly to the server.
[*] [b]TaskOrb for gathering[/b] no longer captures mouse events or displays tooltips.
[/list]

[h2]🧍‍♂️ Player & World Interactions[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Players can now walk through mobs and other players[/b] server-side.
[*] Fixed a bug where [b]tooltips scaled incorrectly[/b], causing them to appear off-screen.
[*] Items dropped to the ground are now [b]visually represented but non-interactable[/b].
[*] Entities spawned via [b]/debug no longer have collision[/b] locally.
[*] [b]Opening the Bank[/b] now also opens your Inventory by default.
[*] UI sync for skills [b]no longer requires spawning as networked objects[/b].
[/list]

[h2]🗺️ Ruins of Silverglow Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lower-level stairs in [b]Ruins of Silverglow[/b] can now be accessed properly.
[*] The ruins no longer stick out of the world terrain visually.
[/list]

[h2]🦀 Beach Crabs & Crusty Bill[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]more Beach Crab spawns[/b] with tighter groupings.
[*] Introduced [b]"Crab Cove" entrance[/b] — currently aesthetic, will be an instanced area later.
[*] Added [b]Crusty Bill[/b], your future guide to instanced Beach Crab content.
[*] Added [b]Crusty Bill's Dock[/b] near Lumirath.
[/list]

[h2]🏦 Endale Banking[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Banker Alaria Silverleaf[/b] is now properly located in Endale and reachable.
[*] Alaria now explains her [b]future plans to open a town bank[/b].
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Internal Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Development tools now better detect [b]invalid NPC spawn groups[/b], preventing unreachable spawns.
[/list]

[h3]Thanks as always for your continued feedback and support. See you in-game![/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.15a - 29th of June 2025
notes.content:
[h1]⚔️ Update Highlights – Quality of Life, Combat Fixes & World Improvements![/h1]

A fresh patch has landed with a bunch of QoL upgrades, combat fixes, and world tweaks. Here's what's new:

[h2]🗺️ Minimap Upgrades[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Click-to-move on the minimap[/b] is now fully functional — navigation just got easier!
[*] A [b]player marker[/b] has been added to the center of the minimap to help you stay oriented.
[/list]

[h2]🌲 Gathering Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]trees weren’t being found[/b] correctly on both client and server during gathering.
[*] Starting a gathering action now shows a [b]chat message[/b] to indicate what you're doing.
[*] Gathering now includes a [b]proper range check[/b] — no more chopping trees from across the map!
[/list]

[h2]👹 World & NPC Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]NPCs now spawn more consistently[/b], aligning better with terrain.
[*] [b]Goblins and other mobs[/b] now spawn closer together for better grouping.
[*] Added [b]more mob spawns[/b] near Lumirath to increase activity in that region.
[*] World list flag icons now function correctly
[*] Fixed terrain holes missing near "/goblin"
[/list]

[h2]🎥 Camera Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] The camera can now be [b]rotated using the arrow keys[/b].
[*] [b]Clicking the minimap compass[/b] resets your camera's rotation and position.
[/list]

[h2]⚔️ Combat Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where [b]combat ticks could break mid-tick[/b], leading to weird or inconsistent behavior.
[*] [b]Combat mode and attack style[/b] now sync correctly across all clients.
[/list]

[h2]🧑‍🌾 Animation Sync & Teleports[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Gathering animations[/b] now properly sync between players.
[*] [b]Teleporting now cancels[/b] both gathering and combat correctly.
[/list]

[h2]🛡️ Server Validation[/h2]
[list]
[*] The [b]server now verifies client build versions[/b] to ensure compatibility.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.14a - 23rd of June 2025
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ Patch Summary[/h1]
This is a big one.

It's a foundational patch — banks, shops, equipment, stats, inventory systems — but it's also intentionally half-finished in parts so we can get crucial performance testing done in a real environment.

The original plan was to ship more polished features, but the systems have been in development for so long that it’s time to see how they hold up under real use. Things like inventory/shop selling and proper coin sources are right around the corner — but for now, use [b]/armor-test[/b] and check [b]/help[/b] for available testing commands.

Going forward, we aim to ship smaller and more frequent updates. This patch got too big and slow.

---

[h1]🎯 Focus Areas for This Patch[/h1]
• Bank System  
• Equipment System  
 – Gear with level requirements  
 – Copper tier armor and weapons (via shop + /armor-test)  
 – NPC dialogue for shop interaction  
• Inventory System (36-slot redesign)  
• Stat Summary UI  
• Context Menus overhaul  
• Shops (no coin source yet, /armor-test fills in)  
• Base Smithing logic (not yet a full skill)  
• First implementation of Equipment Stats  
• Friendly NPC infrastructure  
• Mining skill fully implemented!

---

[h1]📜 Change Log[/h1]

[h2]Core Systems[/h2]
• Bank and Shop systems implemented  
• Inventory slots now 36 (chosen as an "antiprime" for better divisibility in crafting/recipes)  
• Context Menus are now standard for all interactibles and UI  
• Most left-click actions are routed through context menus  
• Shop UI improvements: stock display, price tags, transaction confirmations  
• Tooltips behave differently depending on whether you're banking or shopping  
• Utility Belts (WIP) added — a future system to free up inventory slots during skilling  
• Added item and belt icons for potions, bones, ores, etc.

[h2]Equipment & Stats[/h2]
• Full Copper gear tier implemented  
• All other metal equipment sets are added for future use/testing  
• Equipment Stat Summary UI added  
• Equipment requirements now capped at level 85 (instead of 100)  
 – We found that being able to equip gear earlier than its crafting requirement will benefit the majority of players
• Equipment sounds added  
• Unequipping gear no longer leaves you naked (yay, default clothing!)  
• Combat style now correctly shown in UI  

[h2]Combat & Skilling Systems[/h2]
• Combat now works on a tick system (0.5s intervals)  
• Skilling works on a separate tick system (0.1s intervals)  
• Weapon attack speeds aligned with new tick system  
• Endurance XP is granted every 10 seconds while moving  
• Teleporting gives you any leftover movement XP instantly  
• Stamina drain per second reduced from 5 to 2  
• Minimum drain reduced from 1.0 to 0.5 per second  
• Hovering the stamina bar now shows a tooltip with current drain and recovery rates

[h2]Mining Skill[/h2]
• Implemented Mining Skill and gem drops
• Includes all formulas, restrictions, and balancing logic  
• Could be rebalanced again in the near future  

[h2]World & Zones[/h2]
• Endale (WIP town) now exists in the world  
• Beach Crabs added near Lumirath for early combat testing  
 – Future goal: instanced versions with personal crab zones 🦀  
• Endale bears added for mid-level combat testing  
• Arachnid Lair (/spider) added — future Level 5–35 dungeon  
• Ruins of Silverglow (/goblin) improved  
 – Known issue: dungeon entrance has a bug  
• Expanded world map with placeholders for future zones  
• Pre-rendered minimap system added for performance  
• Assigned expected level ranges to different regions for internal planning  

[h2]NPCs & Dialogue[/h2]
• Friendly NPC infrastructure added (banks, shops, quests)  
• First quest marker system implemented  
• Blue outline appears when hovering over interactible friendly NPCs  
• Tooltips now show an NPC’s “first action” from their right-click menu  

[h2]Chat & UI Improvements[/h2]
• Chat window now includes timestamps  
• Usernames are shown inline with their messages for compact formatting  
• Added Discord join button, website link, and forgot password feature to main menu  
• Reworked main menu playtest disclaimer to clarify wipe policy  
• Added wishlist Call-to-Action for Steam in main menu  

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
• R key toggles run  
• Stamina bar now plays animation when activating run  
• Total XP per skill + total XP shown on hover for individual and total skill display  
• Hovering a depleted resource no longer shows its indicator  
• Dragging an inventory slot highlights its border (even if empty)  
• Values under 1,000,000 now show in full instead of abbreviating  
• Sound volume for level-ups reduced significantly (no more jump scares)  
• Menu world select uses consistent UI now  

[h2]Under the Hood[/h2]
• Inventory and bank storage optimized  
• Database migrated to a more scalable format  
• Now using Unity Virtual Players in local dev for huge speed improvements  

[h2]Design & Icon Work[/h2]
• Loot icons added (bones, feathers, animal parts)  
• Icons for mining, ores, bars, potions, and gems  
• Level badge icons added to nameplates  
• Kiteshields now feel properly metallic  

---

[h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1]
• Auto-retaliate no longer breaks  
• Whispers now show correct "From" player  
• Player names now appear in chat properly  
• Clicking away from a resource now cancels gathering  
• Equipping an item without meeting requirements no longer applies its stats  
• Equipping 2H weapon + shield exploit fixed  
• Gathering tools no longer get unequipped by hand items  
• NavMesh no longer tries to bake without valid ground under player  
• Fixed huge framerate spikes from failed pathing  
• Fixed teleport issues that caused players to float mid-air  
• Skill and stat displays now update properly  
• Fixed tree felling on uneven terrain  
• Equipment stat summary now refreshes correctly  
• Inventory “Withdraw X” stacking bugs fixed  
• Shop transactions now handle item replacements properly  
• Bank/inventory no longer desync visually  
• Context menus now close when clicking outside  
• Flail chain textures restored  
• Chickens no longer delete players via multi-combat glitch  
• Buying partial stacks from shop no longer replaces other items  
• Click-to-move indicator now disappears properly after respawn  
• Roof toggling bug (from nearby players) resolved  
• Equipment icons now disappear correctly when unequipping  

---

[h1]📦 Moved to v1.0.15[/h1]
These features were planned for this patch but will land in the next:

• Starter Quest / Optional Tutorial  
• Home Teleport (first Arcane spellbook entry)  
• Loot Table UI  
• Full World Map  
• Firemaking (first iteration — no bonfires yet)  
• Smithing rebalancing based on skilling rates, AFK timers, etc.

---

[h1]❤️ Thank You[/h1]
Thanks for bearing with this chunky update. We know it's rough in places — but this is a turning point for a lot of systems and paves the way for faster updates from here. Your feedback, bug reports, and stress testing mean the world right now.

Use [b]/armor-test[/b] if you want to jump in and hit stuff fast.  
Use [b]/help[/b] for other fun dev/testing commands (such as /debug-add placements and content creation).

As always — wishlist, tell a friend, or drop by Discord if you haven’t already.  
We're building this together.

notes.title: v1.0.13a - 9th of June 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Change Log[/h1]
This patch has focus on a lot of the fundamentals for the game going forwards.
Everything from polishing combat to implementing server sided skilling as well as the new dungeon system and in-game chat went into this patch.

The entire world is now preloaded server side to prevent loading hiccups
Improved tabbing in login and register windows
Added icons for upcoming beginner area content
Click to move distance has been increased significantly allowing for longer AFK times when travelling
Run energy no longer depletes while not moving
Movement target indicator now correctly faces the camera

[h2]Skilling[/h2]
Added level up sound effect
Added level up notifications
Added some basic tool icons for upcoming skilling content
Added skilling animations
Added skill orbs
 - These track progress to level
 - On experience gain these show the experience gained
Skills now have specific theme colors
Skill window now shows experience progress correctly
Skill window and orbs now show a progress tooltip when hovered

[h2]Chat[/h2]
Added in-game chat
 - This has a few commands, some are temporary, all can be seen in /help or /h
 - This chat currently only works per-world

[h2]Inventory[/h2]
Items can be gained from woodcutting
 - Currently these can only be discarded but does persist per logout/regular intervals
 
 
[h2]Woodcutting[/h2]
Added Initial version of the Woodcutting skill
 - Simply click trees to start gathering
 - Trees can be chopped in groups at no penalty
 - - Everyone gets the same chance at logs as if it was being chopped solo
 - - Trees deplete on fixed timers, this timer is indicated once you start chopping a tree
 - In the future you will benefit from proximity players who chop the same tree
 - Trees will be felled once their Uptime timer kicks in, this uses client side physics but is server-side deterministic
 - - Tree trunks have no impact on other players

[h2]Endurance[/h2]
Added the Endurance skill
 - This can be levelled up by simply moving around the world
 - Experience is gained per distance moved
 - Higher levels reduce Stamina drain and increase Stamina regen while not moving
 
[h2]Dungeons[/h2]
Two of our initial dungeons have been added
 - These are not fully implemented and can simply be explored
 - The Arachnid Lair currently does not toggle roofing when entered and is a lot more work-in-progress than the "/goblin" dungeon
 
[h2]Combat[/h2]
Dealing damage above max health no longer gains additional experience
Improved combat animations
NPC's no longer forcibly remove themselves as target
 - This was causing aggro loss while AFK fighting
NPC's no longer moonwalk when losing target or respawning

notes.title: Update 10th of November 2023
notes.content:
Testing MTX overlay for subscription tokens

NPC's no longer get stuck in spawn

Game now has an established experience formula for all skills

Combat experience can be gained but is not stored yet

Added combat display to the top of screen center

Health bars no longer render behind camera

notes.title: Update 30th of October 2023 - v1.0.9a
notes.content:
Added Starter Town "Lumirath" with roof toggling concept

Loading in should no longer allow players to fall below the terrain

Client and Server now loads terrains in chunks around the world as you walk around, for performance reasons.
Draw distance hard capped to 150 meters
Memory usage reduced drastically
Removed most scarcely used Vegetation to preserve memory

All trees are now the same model until woodcutting implementation to preserve memory
 - When we introduce tiered trees, we will add these as rarer finds around constant spawn locations
